title: Is children's mental health an important function of newly national organization for health crisis management in Japan?
authors: Usami M, Satake N, Katsuyama H, Okudera K, Uchiyama Y, Imamura M, Hayakawa T, Yanai H, Aoyanagi N.
figures: The Japanese new center needs to disseminate evidence‐based information and evidence‐based policy‐making (EBPM) available to protect the children's mental health pre‐pandemic, during a pandemic, and post‐pandemic.
